structure_proposals.why: Every set of dips you have ever logged is bodyweight, so the weight on this one can never go up — reps are the only thing that can climb. The range was raised to 12-20 reps on 14 September and that same night you finished on 19, which used up nearly all of the new room in a single session. A fourth set is the only lever left. Saying yes makes Push B a 25-set night instead of 24.

Your third set of reverse pec deck was cut last week because you had stopped doing it — two sets on 23 August, two on 2 September. That cut was decided on the morning of 14 September, a few minutes before you walked into the gym, and that night you did all three sets, twelve reps each. That is a fact the cut did not have. This asks to write the third set back before Meso 3 starts on 28 September.
